name: SoftBank Osaka Sakai AI data center
aliases: Sharp Sakai Plant AI data center
summary: SoftBank Corp. is converting part of Sharp's former LCD panel plant in Sakai, Osaka into a large AI data center, reusing the plant's land, buildings, power and cooling infrastructure. SoftBank agreed in March 2025 to buy the land and buildings for about 100 billion yen, targeting operation of an initial phase of roughly 150 MW receiving capacity in 2026 and later expansion beyond 250 MW. In 2026 SoftBank described the site as under construction and as the planned home of GPU cloud and sovereign cloud services, alongside AI server assembly and battery manufacturing.

location.note: SoftBank names Sharp's Sakai LCD plant in Sakai City; Sharp gives the plant address as 1 Takumi-cho, Sakai-ku. Coordinates are the OpenStreetMap Nominatim centroid of the Takumi-cho neighbourhood, so they approximate the plant complex rather than the exact SoftBank portion (about 60% of the plant land).

parties.name: SoftBank Corp.
parties.note: Signed a purchase agreement with Sharp Corporation in March 2025 for the land and buildings; Sharp was the seller.

parties.name: OpenAI
parties.note: TechCrunch cited a Nikkei report that OpenAI intends to use GPUs at the Sakai site to develop models for Japan; OpenAI declined to comment, SoftBank did not confirm, and SoftBank's releases do not name OpenAI as a tenant.
